label: Vampire A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact original adult male vampire nobleman: tall lean human build, very pale ivory-gray skin, narrow stern angular face, dark eyes, open small mouth with tiny ivory fangs, short neatly swept dark charcoal-gray hair and a sharp central widow peak. Knee-length rich dark royal-blue long-sleeved coat, fitted waist, wide slightly flared skirt, small pale shirt cuffs, narrow white V-shaped neckline with a small ornate gold neck ornament. A vertical narrow gold embroidered fastening strip with repeated curled loops runs down the front, thin gold coat hem. Broad ornate gold waist belt with the native large oval center buckle and winglike side scrolls. Dark wine-brown burgundy cape hanging from the shoulders to around the knees, tall flared pointed collar with narrow gold edging, scalloped lower cape hem with thin gold trim. Black fitted trousers and plain black calf-high leather boots with small heels. Bare pale empty hands, native long fingers; no weapon. Preserve the exact cape drape and front/back occlusion, native small head, slim long legs, original costume coverage, all hand poses and heavy dark tonal weight. Only native blue coat, burgundy cape and charcoal hair change palette offline; pale skin, gold embroidery and belt, shirt cuffs and black boots remain protected. No added armor, jewelry, symbols, cape clasps, weapons, glowing eyes, bats, magic particles or environment. Reconstruct fine cloth folds, leather grain, delicate hair and restrained gold details without redesign.

materials.limitation: Enhanced cloth/cape/hair coverage approximates native indexed materials; very dark folds and near-neutral highlights may only partly recolor.
